apps.app_name_desc: Application Name, as shown on Moonlight
apps.applications_desc: Applications are refreshed only when Client is restarted
apps.auto_detach: Continue streaming if the application exits quickly
apps.auto_detach_desc: This will attempt to automatically detect launcher-type apps that close quickly after launching another program or instance of themselves. When a launcher-type app is detected, it is treated as a detached app.
apps.cmd_desc: The main application to start. If blank, no application will be started.
apps.cmd_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in quotes.
apps.cmd_prep_desc: A list of commands to be run before/after this application. If any of the prep-commands fail, starting the application is aborted.
apps.cover_apply_failed: Failed to apply cover. Please try again later.
apps.cover_search_failed: Cover search failed. Please try again later.
apps.cover_search_hint: Click a cover to apply it
apps.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?
apps.detached_cmds_desc: A list of commands to be run in the background.
apps.detached_cmds_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in quotes.
apps.env_client_audio_config: The Audio Configuration requested by the client (2.0/5.1/7.1)
apps.env_client_enable_sops: The client has requested the option to optimize the game for optimal streaming (true/false)
apps.env_client_fps: The FPS requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_gcmap: The requested gamepad mask, in a bitset/bitfield format (int)
apps.env_client_hdr: HDR is enabled by the client (true/false)
apps.env_client_height: The Height requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_host_audio: The client has requested host audio (true/false)
apps.env_client_width: The Width requested by the client (int)
apps.env_vars_desc: All commands get these environment variables by default:
apps.exit_timeout_desc: Number of seconds to wait for all app processes to gracefully exit when requested to quit. If unset, the default is to wait up to 5 seconds. If set to zero or a negative value, the app will be immediately terminated.
apps.gamepad_mode_desc: Override the virtual controller type for this application. Inherit uses the global Input setting; Auto selects from the controller capabilities reported by the client.
apps.global_prep_desc: Enable/Disable the execution of Global Prep Commands for this application.
apps.image_desc: Application icon/picture/image path that will be sent to client. Image must be a PNG file. If not set, Sunshine will send default box image.
apps.menu_cmd_desc:
After configuration, these commands will be visible in the client's return menu, allowing quick execution of specific operations without interrupting the stream, such as launching helper programs.
Example: Display Name - Close your computer; Command - shutdown -s -t 10
apps.mouse_mode_desc: Select the mouse input method for this application. Auto uses the global setting, Virtual Mouse uses the HID driver, SendInput uses the Windows API.
apps.name: Name
apps.output_desc: The file where the output of the command is stored, if it is not specified, the output is ignored
apps.rtx_hdr_desc: Convert this application's captured SDR frames to HDR before encoding. The client must request HDR, and NVIDIA RTX HDR must be enabled in the GUI's HDR Enhancement panel.
apps.run_as_desc: This can be necessary for some applications that require administrator permissions to run properly.
apps.scan_result_search_placeholder: Search application name, command or path...
apps.wait_all: Continue streaming until all app processes exit
apps.wait_all_desc: This will continue streaming until all processes started by the app have terminated. When unchecked, streaming will stop when the initial app process exits, even if other app processes are still running.
apps.working_dir_desc: The working directory that should be passed to the process. For example, some applications use the working directory to search for configuration files. If not set, Sunshine will default to the parent directory of the command

config.usb_forwarding_description: Allow paired clients to forward explicitly selected USB devices. Requires the Windows USB/IP driver. Save and restart Sunshine; clients obtain connection credentials automatically. Do not enable for untrusted clients.
config.usb_forwarding_port_hint: 0: automatic (main port + 7; normally 47996). Set 1024–65535 to override. Clients discover the actual port from the host.
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_1: Manually specify a GPU to use for capture.
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_2: to find all devices capable of VAAPI
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_3: Replace ``renderD129`` with the device from above to lists the name and capabilities of the device. To be supported by Sunshine, it needs to have at the very minimum:
config.adapter_name_desc_windows: Manually specify a GPU to use for capture. If unset, the GPU is chosen automatically. Note: This GPU must have a display connected and powered on. If your laptop cannot enable direct GPU output, please set this to automatic.
config.adapter_name_desc_windows_vdd_hint: If the latest version of the virtual display is installed, it can automatically associate with the GPU binding
config.address_family_desc: Set the address family used by Sunshine
config.always_send_scancodes_desc: Sending scancodes enhances compatibility with games and apps but may result in incorrect keyboard input from certain clients that aren't using a US English keyboard layout. Enable if keyboard input is not working at all in certain applications. Disable if keys on the client are generating the wrong input on the host.
config.amd_advanced_group_desc: Optional driver-level AMF properties. Leaving everything blank uses Sunshine's recommended defaults: standalone AV1 uses an input queue of 1 when pre-analysis and multi-HW are disabled, while other properties and modes normally keep driver defaults. Tune these for lower latency or to work around hardware/driver bugs such as issue #666.
config.amd_av1_latency_mode_desc: AV1-only latency mode. Leave blank for driver default. Sunshine's legacy value was 'lowest latency'. If unsure, keep the driver default.
config.amd_avcodec_compat_desc: Disabled by default to use Sunshine's clean standalone AMF path. Enable only if you hit device/client compatibility issues and want to try the AVCodec-like AMF compatibility layer.
config.amd_capture_no_virtual_display: AMD Display Capture does not support virtual display drivers (e.g. IddCx/VDD). If you are using a virtual display, please use WGC or Desktop Duplication API instead.
config.amd_coder_desc: Select CABAC or CAVLC entropy coding for H.264 only. Leave Auto unless debugging compatibility or performance.
config.amd_enforce_hrd_desc: Increases the constraints on rate control to meet HRD model requirements. This greatly reduces bitrate overflows, but may cause encoding artifacts or reduced quality on certain cards.
config.amd_high_motion_qb_desc: Encoder-level quality boost for fast-moving content. Leave blank to use the driver default. 'Enabled' was the legacy Sunshine behavior and may improve quality; 'Disabled' if you hit driver freezes.
config.amd_input_queue_size_desc: Frames the encoder may buffer internally (1-16). Blank uses 1 for standalone AV1, or the driver default for H.264/HEVC and AV1 pre-analysis/multi-HW modes. Lower = lower latency; higher = more stable.
config.amd_lowlatency_mode_desc: AMD VCN low-latency code path. Leave blank to use the driver default. 'Enabled' was the legacy Sunshine behavior and minimizes latency; 'Disabled' if you hit driver freezes (RX 9070 / RDNA4 H.264/HEVC).
config.amd_multi_hw_instance_desc: Opt-in AMD multi hardware encoder path. Leave blank for driver default. On HEVC/AV1 this enables multi-HW instance encode and Smart Access Video when supported; on H.264 only Smart Access Video is available.
config.amd_preanalysis_desc: This enables rate-control preanalysis, which may increase quality at the expense of increased encoding latency.
config.amd_quality_desc: This controls the balance between encoding speed and quality.
config.amd_qvbr_quality_desc: Quality level for QVBR rate control mode. Range: 1-51 (higher = better quality). Default: 23. Only applies when rate control is set to 'qvbr'.
config.amd_rc_cbr: cbr -- constant bitrate (recommended if HRD is enabled)
config.amd_rc_desc: This controls the rate control method to ensure we are not exceeding the client bitrate target. 'cqp' is not suitable for bitrate targeting, and other options besides 'vbr_latency' depend on HRD Enforcement to help constrain bitrate overflows.
config.amd_rc_qvbr: qvbr -- quality variable bitrate (uses QVBR quality level)
config.amd_rc_vbr_latency: vbr_latency -- latency constrained variable bitrate (recommended if HRD is disabled)
config.amd_slices_per_frame_desc: Splits each frame into multiple slices/tiles for parallel encoding and decoding, which can reduce latency. For H.264/HEVC this sets slices per frame; for AV1 this sets tiles per frame. Set to 0 to let the client decide.
config.amd_usage_desc: This sets the base encoding profile. All options presented below will override a subset of the usage profile, but there are additional hidden settings applied that cannot be configured elsewhere.
config.amd_vbaq_desc: The human visual system is typically less sensitive to artifacts in highly textured areas. In VBAQ mode, pixel variance is used to indicate the complexity of spatial textures, allowing the encoder to allocate more bits to smoother areas. Enabling this feature leads to improvements in subjective visual quality with some content.
config.amf_draw_mouse_cursor: Draw a simple cursor when using AMF capture method
config.amf_draw_mouse_cursor_desc: In some cases, using AMF capture will not display the mouse pointer. Enabling this option will draw a simple mouse pointer on the screen. Note: The position of the mouse pointer will only be updated when there is an update to the content screen, so in non-game scenarios such as on the desktop, you may observe sluggish mouse pointer movement.
config.apply_note: Click 'Apply' to restart Sunshine and apply changes. This will terminate any running sessions.
config.audio_sink_desc_linux: The name of the audio sink used for Audio Loopback. If you do not specify this variable, pulseaudio will select the default monitor device. You can find the name of the audio sink using either command:
config.audio_sink_desc_macos: The name of the audio sink used for Audio Loopback. Sunshine can only access microphones on macOS due to system limitations. To stream system audio using Soundflower or BlackHole.
config.audio_sink_desc_windows: Manually specify a specific audio device to capture. If unset, the device is chosen automatically. We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic device selection! If you have multiple audio devices with identical names, you can get the Device ID using the following command:
config.av1_mode_0: Sunshine will advertise support for AV1 based on encoder capabilities (recommended)
config.av1_mode_1: Sunshine will not advertise support for AV1
config.av1_mode_2: Sunshine will advertise support for AV1 Main 8-bit profile
config.av1_mode_3: Sunshine will advertise support for AV1 Main 8-bit and 10-bit (HDR) profiles
config.av1_mode_desc: Allows the client to request AV1 Main 8-bit or 10-bit video streams. AV1 is more CPU-intensive to encode, so enabling this may reduce performance when using software encoding.
config.back_button_timeout_desc: If the Back/Select button is held down for the specified number of milliseconds, a Home/Guide button press is emulated. If set to a value < 0 (default), holding the Back/Select button will not emulate the Home/Guide button.
config.bind_address_desc: Set the specific IP address Sunshine will bind to. If left blank, Sunshine will bind to all available addresses.
config.capture_compute_shader_desc: Choose how Sunshine prepares frames for the encoder. Automatic uses the faster GPU path when it is supported and beneficial, then safely falls back when needed. Performance first always attempts acceleration; use compatibility first only when troubleshooting capture or visual issues.
config.capture_cursor_desc: Turn off to hide the mouse cursor in the stream. Can be toggled live with Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N.
config.capture_desc: On automatic mode Sunshine will use the first one that works. NvFBC requires patched nvidia drivers.
config.capture_target_desc: Select the type of target to capture. When selecting 'Window', you can capture a specific application window (such as AI frame interpolation software) instead of the entire display.
config.capture_vdd_direct_desc: Recommended for Zako virtual displays. Captures the VDD shared frame directly and falls back safely when zero-copy handoff is unavailable.
config.cert_desc: The certificate used for the web UI and Moonlight client pairing. For best compatibility, this should have an RSA-2048 public key.
config.channels_desc_1: Sunshine can allow a single streaming session to be shared with multiple clients simultaneously.
config.channels_desc_2: Some hardware encoders may have limitations that reduce performance with multiple streams.
config.close_verify_safe: Safe Verify Compatible with Old Clients
config.close_verify_safe_desc: Old clients may not be able to connect to Sunshine, please disable this option or update the client
config.codec_advanced_show: Show advanced options (configure HEVC / AV1 separately)
config.codec_enable_hdr_disabled_hint: HDR is only adjustable under 'Prefer modern codecs'. 'Automatic' decides this for you based on encoder capability.
config.codec_strategy_desc: Controls which video codecs Sunshine advertises to Moonlight. The default 'Automatic' picks based on encoder capability and is right for ~99% of users. Switch to 'H.264 only' if your client shows a black/green screen or HDR colors look wrong.
config.codec_strategy_non_default_warning: You are using a non-default strategy. Some clients may fail to connect or fall back to a lower quality. Restore 'Automatic (recommended)' if you encounter issues.
config.coder_cabac: cabac -- context adaptive binary arithmetic coding - higher quality
config.coder_cavlc: cavlc -- context adaptive variable-length coding - faster decode
config.controller_desc: Allows guests to control the host system with a gamepad / controller
config.credentials_file_desc: Store Username/Password separately from Sunshine's state file.
config.display_device_options_note_desc_windows:
Windows saves various display settings for each combination of currently active displays.
Sunshine then applies changes to a display(-s) belonging to such a display combination.
If you disconnect a device which was active when Sunshine applied the settings, the changes can not be
reverted back unless the combination can be activated again by the time Sunshine tries to revert changes!
config.display_device_options_note_windows: Note about how settings are applied
config.display_device_prep_ensure_active_desc_w: Activates the display if it is not already active
config.display_device_prep_ensure_only_display_: Disables all other displays, only enables the specified display
config.display_device_prep_ensure_primary_desc_: Activates the display and sets it as the primary display
config.display_device_prep_ensure_primary_windo: Primary Display Streaming (Auto-Activate & Set as Primary)
config.display_device_prep_ensure_secondary_des: Uses only the virtual display for secondary extended streaming
config.display_device_prep_no_operation_desc_wi: No changes to display state; user must ensure display is ready
config.display_mode_remapping_default_mode_desc:
At least one "received" and one "final" value must be specified.
Empty field in "received" section means "match any". Empty field in "final" section means "keep received value".
You can match specific FPS value to specific resolution if you wish so...

Note: if "Optimize game settings" option is not enabled on the Moonlight client, the rows containing resolution value(-s) are ignored.
config.display_mode_remapping_desc_windows:
Specify how a specific resolution and/or refresh rate should be remapped to other values.
You can stream at lower resolution, while rendering at higher resolution on host for a supersampling effect.
Or you can stream at higher FPS while limiting the host to the lower refresh rate.
Matching is performed top to bottom. Once the entry is matched, others are no longer checked, but still validated.
config.display_mode_remapping_resolution_only_m: Note: if "Optimize game settings" option is not enabled on the Moonlight client, the remapping is disabled.
config.ds4_back_as_touchpad_click_desc: When forcing DS4 emulation, map Back/Select to Touchpad Click
config.dsu_server_port_desc: DSU server listening port (default 26760). Sunshine will act as a DSU server to receive client connections and send motion data. Enable DSU server in your client(Yuzu,Ryujinx etc.) and set DSU server address(127.0.0.1) and port(26760)
config.dynamic_resolution_follow_display_desc: When enabled (default), if the host display resolution changes during a stream, the encoder re-initializes at the new resolution and a protocol extension message tells the client to re-create its decoder. Modern Moonlight clients (Desktop / Android / iOS) handle this seamlessly. Disable this option for legacy clients that don't implement the extension (e.g. PSVita Moonlight) — the stream resolution will then stay fixed and the encoder's scaler will adapt to host display changes, matching upstream Sunshine behavior.
config.enable_dsu_server_desc: Enable DSU server to receive client connections and send motion data
config.encoder_desc: Force a specific encoder, otherwise Sunshine will select the best available option. Note: If you specify a hardware encoder on Windows, it must match the GPU where the display is connected.
config.external_ip_desc: If no external IP address is given, Sunshine will automatically detect external IP
config.fec_percentage_desc: Percentage of error correcting packets per data packet in each video frame. Higher values can correct for more network packet loss, but at the cost of increasing bandwidth usage.
config.file_apps_desc: The file where current apps of Sunshine are stored.
config.file_state_desc: The file where current state of Sunshine is stored
config.gamepad_desc: Choose which type of gamepad to emulate on the host
config.gamepad_ds5_component_hint_windows: DualSense is the PlayStation 5 controller. On Windows, open Sunshine GUI → Device Hub → Controllers to install or repair its optional component. If the component is unavailable, Sunshine uses automatic controller selection instead. The change applies from the next stream without restarting Sunshine.
config.global_prep_cmd_desc: Configure a list of commands to be executed before or after running any application. If any of the specified preparation commands fail, the application launch process will be aborted.
config.hdr_luminance_analysis_desc: Adapts HDR metadata to each scene so compatible displays can preserve more highlight and shadow detail. Supports HDR Vivid and HDR10+. Adds minor GPU usage (about 0.5–1.5 ms per frame at high resolutions); when disabled, Sunshine uses baseline HDR metadata.
config.hdr_prep_automatic_windows: Switch on/off the HDR mode as requested by the client
config.hdr_runtime_status_fallback: Scene analysis is unavailable; using baseline HDR metadata
config.hdr_runtime_status_sdr: The current stream is SDR; HDR analysis is idle
config.hdr_runtime_status_starting: HDR stream detected; preparing scene metadata…
config.hdr_runtime_status_waiting: Ready — waiting for an HDR stream
config.hevc_mode_0: Sunshine will advertise support for HEVC based on encoder capabilities (recommended)
config.hevc_mode_1: Sunshine will not advertise support for HEVC
config.hevc_mode_2: Sunshine will advertise support for HEVC Main profile
config.hevc_mode_3: Sunshine will advertise support for HEVC Main and Main10 (HDR) profiles
config.hevc_mode_desc: Allows the client to request HEVC Main or HEVC Main10 video streams. HEVC is more CPU-intensive to encode, so enabling this may reduce performance when using software encoding.
config.high_resolution_scrolling_desc: When enabled, Sunshine will pass through high resolution scroll events from Moonlight clients. This can be useful to disable for older applications that scroll too fast with high resolution scroll events.
config.install_steam_audio_drivers_desc: If Steam is installed, this will automatically install the Steam Streaming Speakers driver to support 5.1/7.1 surround sound and muting host audio.
config.key_repeat_delay_desc: Control how fast keys will repeat themselves. The initial delay in milliseconds before repeating keys.
config.key_repeat_frequency_desc: How often keys repeat every second. This configurable option supports decimals.
config.key_rightalt_to_key_win: Map Right Alt key to Windows key
config.key_rightalt_to_key_win_desc: It may be possible that you cannot send the Windows Key from Moonlight directly. In those cases it may be useful to make Sunshine think the Right Alt key is the Windows key
config.key_rightalt_to_key_windows: Map Right Alt key to Windows key
config.keyboard_desc: Allows guests to control the host system with the keyboard
config.lan_encryption_mode_desc: This determines when encryption will be used when streaming over your local network. Encryption can reduce streaming performance, particularly on less powerful hosts and clients.
config.locale_desc: The locale used for Sunshine's user interface.
config.log_level_desc: The minimum log level printed to standard out
config.log_path_desc: The file where the current logs of Sunshine are stored.
config.max_bitrate_desc: The maximum bitrate (in Kbps) that Sunshine will encode the stream at. If set to 0, it will always use the bitrate requested by Moonlight.
config.mdns_broadcast: Find this computer in the local network
config.mdns_broadcast_desc: If this option is enabled, Sunshine will allow other devices to find this computer automatically. Moonlight must also be configured to find this computer automatically in the local network.
config.microphone_redirect_apply_note: Backend changes take effect after saving and applying the configuration.
config.microphone_redirect_backend_desc: Select how Moonlight microphone audio is exposed to Windows applications.
config.microphone_redirect_usbip_warning: Experimental: requires the signed Virtual Device Host component and currently uses the DualSense composite prototype profile.
config.min_threads_desc: Minimum thread count used by software encoding and its CPU-based scaling and pixel-format conversion. This does not control NVENC, AMF, QSV, or other hardware encoders.
config.minimum_fps_target_desc: Minimum FPS to maintain when encoding (0 = auto, about half the stream FPS; 1-1000 = minimum FPS to maintain). When variable refresh rate is enabled, this setting is ignored if set to 0.
config.motion_as_ds4: Emulate a DS4 gamepad if the client gamepad reports motion sensors are present
config.motion_as_ds4_desc: If disabled, motion sensors will not be taken into account during gamepad type selection.
config.mouse_desc: Allows guests to control the host system with the mouse
config.native_pen_touch_desc: When enabled, Sunshine will pass through native pen/touch events from Moonlight clients. This can be useful to disable for older applications without native pen/touch support.
config.native_touchpad_optimization_desc: When enabled, Sunshine enables near-native touchpad support for native touchpads. When disabled, it falls back to legacy touchpad events.
config.notify_pre_releases_desc: Whether to be notified of new pre-release versions of Sunshine
config.nvenc_cuda_array_input_desc: Windows only. Feed 10-bit 4:4:4 frames to NVENC through a block-linear CUDA array instead of the pitch-linear device pointer. Requires a driver with NVENC 13.1 or newer; older drivers ignore this and keep using the device pointer. Experimental: some drivers produce ghosted output, and some stall while Sunshine probes encoders at startup, which prevents the web UI from becoming reachable. If that happens you cannot turn this back off from here — stop the Sunshine service, set nvenc_cuda_array_input = disabled in sunshine.conf, then start the service again. Leave disabled unless you are testing it.
config.nvenc_h264_cavlc: Prefer CAVLC over CABAC in H.264
config.nvenc_h264_cavlc_desc: Simpler form of entropy coding. CAVLC needs around 10% more bitrate for same quality. Only relevant for really old decoding devices.
config.nvenc_latency_over_power: Prefer lower encoding latency over power savings
config.nvenc_latency_over_power_desc: Sunshine requests maximum GPU clock speed while streaming to reduce encoding latency. Disabling it is not recommended since this can lead to significantly increased encoding latency.
config.nvenc_lookahead_depth_desc: Number of frames to look ahead during encoding (0-32). Lookahead improves encoding quality, especially in complex scenes, by providing better motion estimation and bitrate distribution. Higher values improve quality but increase encoding latency. Set to 0 to disable lookahead. Requires NVENC SDK 13.0 (1202) or newer.
config.nvenc_lookahead_level_desc: Lookahead quality level. Higher levels improve quality at the expense of performance. This option only takes effect when lookahead_depth is greater than 0. Requires NVENC SDK 13.0 (1202) or newer.
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi: Present OpenGL/Vulkan on top of DXGI
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi_desc: Sunshine can't capture fullscreen OpenGL and Vulkan programs at full frame rate unless they present on top of DXGI. This is system-wide setting that is reverted on sunshine program exit.
config.nvenc_preset_desc: Higher numbers improve compression (quality at given bitrate) at the cost of increased encoding latency. Recommended to change only when limited by network or decoder, otherwise similar effect can be accomplished by increasing bitrate.
config.nvenc_rate_control_desc: Select rate control mode. CBR (Constant Bitrate) provides fixed bitrate for low latency streaming. VBR (Variable Bitrate) allows bitrate to vary based on scene complexity, providing better quality for complex scenes at the cost of variable bitrate.
config.nvenc_realtime_hags: Use realtime priority in hardware accelerated gpu scheduling
config.nvenc_realtime_hags_desc: Currently NVIDIA drivers may freeze in encoder when HAGS is enabled, realtime priority is used and VRAM utilization is close to maximum. Disabling this option lowers the priority to high, sidestepping the freeze at the cost of reduced capture performance when the GPU is heavily loaded.
config.nvenc_spatial_aq_desc: Assign higher QP values to flat regions of the video. Recommended to enable when streaming at lower bitrates.
config.nvenc_split_encode_desc: Split the encoding of each video frame over multiple NVENC hardware units. Significantly reduces encoding latency with a marginal compression efficiency penalty. This option is ignored if your GPU has a singular NVENC unit.
config.nvenc_target_quality_desc: Target quality level for VBR mode (0-51 for H.264/HEVC, 0-63 for AV1). Lower values = higher quality. Set to 0 for automatic quality selection. Only used when rate control mode is VBR.
config.nvenc_temporal_aq_desc: Enable temporal adaptive quantization. Temporal AQ optimizes quantization across time, providing better bitrate distribution and improved quality in motion scenes. This feature works in conjunction with spatial AQ and requires lookahead to be enabled (lookahead_depth > 0). Requires NVENC SDK 13.0 (1202) or newer.
config.nvenc_temporal_filter_desc: Temporal filtering strength applied before encoding. Temporal filter reduces noise and improves compression efficiency, especially for natural content. Higher levels provide better noise reduction but may introduce slight blurring. Requires NVENC SDK 13.0 (1202) or newer. Note: Requires frameIntervalP >= 5, not compatible with zeroReorderDelay or stereo MVC.
config.nvenc_twopass_desc: Adds preliminary encoding pass. This allows to detect more motion vectors, better distribute bitrate across the frame and more strictly adhere to bitrate limits. Disabling it is not recommended since this can lead to occasional bitrate overshoot and subsequent packet loss.
config.nvenc_vbv_increase_desc: By default sunshine uses single-frame VBV/HRD, which means any encoded video frame size is not expected to exceed requested bitrate divided by requested frame rate. Relaxing this restriction can be beneficial and act as low-latency variable bitrate, but may also lead to packet loss if the network doesn't have buffer headroom to handle bitrate spikes. Maximum accepted value is 400, which corresponds to 5x increased encoded video frame upper size limit.
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_desc: The origin of the remote endpoint address that is not denied access to Web UI
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_lan: Only those in LAN may access Web UI
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_pc: Only localhost may access Web UI
config.output_name_desc_unix: During Sunshine startup, you should see the list of detected displays. Note: You need to use the id value inside the parenthesis.
config.output_name_desc_windows:
Manually specify a display device id to use for capture. If unset, the primary display is captured.
Note: If you specified a GPU above, this display must be connected to that GPU.

During Sunshine startup, you should see the list of detected display devices and their ids, e.g.:
config.pair_max_attempts_desc: Max PIN pairing attempts per client IP within 60 seconds. Range 0-50, 0 disables the limit. Default is 10.
config.ping_timeout_desc: How long to wait in milliseconds for data from moonlight before shutting down the stream
config.pkey_desc: The private key used for the web UI and Moonlight client pairing. For best compatibility, this should be an RSA-2048 private key.
config.port_desc: Set the family of ports used by Sunshine
config.port_http_port_note: Use this port to connect with Moonlight.
config.port_warning: Exposing the Web UI to the internet is a security risk! Proceed at your own risk!
config.port_web_ui_proxy_warning: If you reverse proxy the Web UI, use the Sunshine host's actual network-interface IP as the upstream address. Do not use localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, or the IPv6 loopback address ::1 as the proxy target.
config.qp_desc: Some devices may not support Constant Bit Rate. For those devices, QP is used instead. Higher value means more compression, but less quality.
config.qsv_slow_hevc_desc: This can enable HEVC encoding on older Intel GPUs, at the cost of higher GPU usage and worse performance.
config.refresh_rate_change_automatic_windows: Use FPS value provided by the client
config.refresh_rate_change_manual_desc_windows: Enter the refresh rate to be used
config.res_fps_desc: These are the resolution and frame-rate options Sunshine advertises to clients; they do not directly control the streamed picture. The presets cover most clients. Zako VDD automatically adapts its display mode to the client request, so editing these lists is not recommended unless a client requires an unlisted mode.
config.resolution_change_automatic_windows: Use resolution provided by the client
config.resolution_change_manual_desc_windows: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled on the Moonlight client for this to work.
config.resolution_change_ogs_desc_windows: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled on the Moonlight client for this to work.
config.restart_note: Sunshine is restarting to apply changes.

risk_confirm.intro_apply: These changes may affect security, active sessions, or host display state. Review them before Sunshine restarts.
risk_confirm.intro_save: These settings can affect security, host state, or commands executed by Sunshine. Review them before saving.

display_device_prep.description: Sunshine will change the host display topology when a stream starts. This can affect the local monitor layout.
display_device_prep.only_display_description: Sunshine will disable other displays and keep only the selected display active. If the selected display is unavailable, the host may appear blank locally. Hosts with DisplayPort or USB-C DP physical monitors may experience periodic stutter caused by hot-plug or automatic input scanning; if this happens, use Primary/Secondary Display Streaming or disable automatic input scanning/detection in the monitor menu.
display_device_prep.recovery: If the display state is wrong, restore this option to Disabled or use the Troubleshooting page to reset display device persistence.
display_device_prep.title: Display topology will be changed

display_mode_change.description: Sunshine will change resolution or refresh rate for streaming sessions.
display_mode_change.recovery: Restore Resolution change and FPS change to Disabled if the monitor does not return to the expected mode.
display_mode_change.title: Display mode automation changed

display_mode_remapping.description: Client-requested display modes will be remapped before Sunshine applies them.
display_mode_remapping.recovery: Remove the remapping rules if clients receive an unexpected resolution or refresh rate.
display_mode_remapping.title: Display mode remapping changed

elevated_global_commands.description: Global preparation commands include elevated commands. They can change system state before or after any app launch.
elevated_global_commands.title: Elevated global commands

experimental_capture.description: This capture backend is experimental or has known compatibility limits on some systems.
experimental_capture.recovery: Switch Capture back to Autodetect, WGC, or Desktop Duplication API if capture fails.
experimental_capture.title: Experimental capture backend

global_prep_commands.description: Global preparation commands run before or after any app launch. A failed command can abort app startup.
global_prep_commands.recovery: Remove or disable the global commands if app launch behavior becomes unexpected.
global_prep_commands.title: Global commands will run for apps

pair_limit_disabled.description: Setting the pairing attempt limit to 0 removes the per-IP rate limit for pairing attempts.
pair_limit_disabled.recovery: Set Pair max attempts back to a finite value such as 10.
pair_limit_disabled.title: Pairing attempt limit disabled

restart.description: Applying configuration restarts Sunshine and terminates any active streaming sessions.
restart.recovery: Save without applying if you want to restart later when nobody is connected.
restart.title: Sunshine will restart

sensitive_files_changed.description: Changing credential, certificate, key, or state file paths can affect login, pairing, and stored client state.
sensitive_files_changed.recovery: Restore the previous file paths if authentication, pairing, or client state behaves unexpectedly.
sensitive_files_changed.title: Sensitive file paths changed

upnp_enabled.description: UPnP can automatically open router ports for Internet streaming.
upnp_enabled.recovery: Disable UPnP if you do not want Sunshine to request router port mappings.
upnp_enabled.title: UPnP port mapping enabled

wan_encryption_disabled.description: WAN streaming traffic may be sent without Sunshine's stream encryption.
wan_encryption_disabled.recovery: Use Supported clients or Force encryption for WAN streaming unless you have a specific compatibility need.
wan_encryption_disabled.title: WAN encryption disabled

web_ui_wan.description: The Web UI will be reachable from Internet-origin requests. Password protection still applies, but exposure increases attack surface.
web_ui_wan.recovery: Use LAN or Local PC access unless you intentionally expose the Web UI through a secured network path.
web_ui_wan.title: Web UI exposed to WAN

webhook_enabled.description: Sunshine will send event data to the configured webhook endpoint.
webhook_enabled.recovery: Disable webhook notifications or remove the URL if this endpoint should not receive Sunshine events.
webhook_enabled.title: Webhook notifications enabled

webhook_skip_ssl_verify.description: HTTPS webhook certificates will not be verified, which can allow interception by an untrusted endpoint.
webhook_skip_ssl_verify.recovery: Disable this option after testing or use a certificate trusted by the host.
webhook_skip_ssl_verify.title: Webhook SSL verification skipped

wgc_disable_secure_desktop.description: During WGC streaming, administrator elevation prompts can be auto-approved without a visible confirmation.
wgc_disable_secure_desktop.recovery: Disable this option unless you specifically need unattended remote elevation during a trusted session.
wgc_disable_secure_desktop.title: UAC secure desktop bypass enabled

config.sleep_mode_desc: Controls what happens when the client sends a sleep command. Suspend (S3): traditional sleep, low power but requires WOL to wake. Hibernate (S4): saves to disk, very low power. Away Mode: display turns off but system stays running for instant wake - ideal for game streaming servers.
config.stream_audio_desc: Disable this option to stop audio streaming.
config.stream_mic_desc: Disable this option to stop microphone streaming.
config.stream_mic_download_confirm: You are about to be redirected to the virtual microphone download page. Continue?
config.stream_mic_note: This feature requires installing a virtual microphone
config.stream_mic_test_device_unavailable: VB-Cable is unavailable. Install it and make sure both CABLE Input and CABLE Output are enabled.
config.stream_mic_test_failed: The test tone could not be written to the virtual microphone.
config.stream_mic_test_note: Open the input meter for CABLE Output, then run the test.
config.stream_mic_test_note_usbip: The USB/IP backend injects PCM directly; no VB-Cable loopback is used. Save and apply changes before testing.
config.stream_mic_test_success: Test tone sent. Confirm that the CABLE Output input meter moved.
config.stream_mic_test_success_usbip: Test tone injected into the USB/IP virtual microphone.
config.stream_mic_test_usbip_unavailable: The signed Virtual Device Host component is unavailable or could not be started.
config.sunshine_name_desc: The name displayed by Moonlight. If not specified, the PC's hostname is used
config.sw_preset_desc: Optimize the trade-off between encoding speed (encoded frames per second) and compression efficiency (quality per bit in the bitstream). Defaults to superfast.
config.sw_tune_animation: animation -- good for cartoons; uses higher deblocking and more reference frames
config.sw_tune_desc: Tuning options, which are applied after the preset. Defaults to zerolatency.
config.sw_tune_fastdecode: fastdecode -- allows faster decoding by disabling certain filters
config.sw_tune_film: film -- use for high quality movie content; lowers deblocking
config.sw_tune_grain: grain -- preserves the grain structure in old, grainy film material
config.sw_tune_zerolatency: zerolatency -- good for fast encoding and low-latency streaming (default)
config.system_tray_desc: Whether to enable system tray. If enabled, Sunshine will display an icon in the system tray and can be controlled from the system tray.
config.touchpad_as_ds4: Emulate a DS4 gamepad if the client gamepad reports a touchpad is present
config.touchpad_as_ds4_desc: If disabled, touchpad presence will not be taken into account during gamepad type selection.
config.unsaved_changes_tooltip: You have unsaved changes. Click to save.
config.upnp_desc: Automatically configure port forwarding for streaming over the Internet
config.variable_refresh_rate_desc: Allow video stream framerate to match render framerate for VRR support. When enabled, encoding only occurs when new frames are available, allowing the stream to follow the actual render framerate.
config.vdd_borrowed_texture_desc: Let Zako Direct borrow the current VDD frame texture and return it after conversion. Recommended; it falls back to the copy path if the handoff is blocked or unsupported.
config.vdd_driver_browser_hint: Open the Sunshine desktop app on the host, go to VDD settings, and install or repair the driver.
config.vdd_driver_desktop_hint: Install or repair the bundled driver here. Sunshine will verify it before continuing.
config.vdd_driver_state_degraded: The driver is installed but its modern control interface is unavailable.
config.vdd_driver_state_not_installed: The ZakoVDD adapter is not installed.
config.vdd_driver_state_payload_missing: The bundled driver payload is missing. Repair Sunshine first.
config.vdd_driver_state_reboot_required: Restart Windows to finish enabling the driver.
config.vdd_driver_state_unhealthy: The driver is installed but Windows reports a problem.
config.vdd_driver_state_unknown: Sunshine could not verify the driver state.
config.vdd_driver_state_unsupported: VDD driver management is only available on Windows.
config.vdd_reuse_desc_windows: When enabled, all clients will share the same VDD (Virtual Display Device). When disabled (default), each client gets its own unique VDD. Enable this for faster client switching, but note that all clients will share the same display settings.
config.vdd_reuse_windows: Reuse Same VDD for All Clients
config.vdd_vulkan_hdr_bridge_desc_windows: Helps Vulkan games detect HDR on Zako virtual displays. It activates only for an HDR stream, and validation failures do not interrupt streaming.
config.vdd_vulkan_hdr_bridge_status_enabled_win: Active for the current HDR stream
config.vdd_vulkan_hdr_bridge_status_waiting_dis: Ready — waiting for an HDR Zako virtual display
config.vdd_vulkan_hdr_bridge_validate_hint_wind: Start an HDR Zako virtual display to enable testing.
config.vdd_vulkan_hdr_bridge_windows: Vulkan HDR compatibility for virtual displays
config.vigem_confirm_reinstall: Force reinstall ViGEmBus from the latest GitHub release? This will run the installer even when a compatible version is already present.
config.vigem_confirm_uninstall: Uninstall the ViGEmBus driver? Emulated gamepads will stop working until reinstalled.
config.vigem_desc: ViGEmBus is required on Windows for emulated gamepads (Xbox 360 / DualShock 4). Sunshine ships an installer; the panel below lets you install or update it without leaving the web UI.
config.vigem_reinstall_desc: Force download and reinstall the latest ViGEmBus release, bypassing the bat's >=1.17 skip check.
config.virtual_mouse_desc: When enabled, Sunshine will use the Zako Virtual Mouse driver (if installed) to simulate mouse input at the HID level. This allows games using Raw Input to receive mouse events. When disabled or driver not installed, falls back to SendInput.
config.virtual_sink_desc: Manually specify a virtual audio device to use. If unset, the device is chosen automatically. We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic device selection!
config.vmouse_note: The virtual mouse driver requires separate installation. Please use the Sunshine Control Panel to install or manage the driver.
config.wan_encryption_mode_desc: This determines when encryption will be used when streaming over the Internet. Encryption can reduce streaming performance, particularly on less powerful hosts and clients.
config.webhook_curl_command_desc: Choose the template for your terminal and run the command to test the webhook:
config.webhook_curl_copy_failed: Copy failed, please manually select and copy
config.webhook_enabled_desc: When enabled, Sunshine will send event notifications to the specified Webhook URL
config.webhook_events_desc: Select which events are sent. The configuration file stores the selected numeric IDs as a comma-separated list; all events are selected by default.
config.webhook_skip_ssl_verify_desc: Skip SSL certificate verification for HTTPS connections, only for testing or self-signed certificates
config.webhook_test_failed_note: Note: Please check if the URL is correct, or check the browser console for more information.
config.webhook_test_success_cors_note:
Note: Due to CORS restrictions, the server response status cannot be confirmed.
The request has been sent. If the webhook is configured correctly, the message should have been delivered.

Suggestion: Check the Network tab in your browser's developer tools for request details.
config.webhook_timeout_desc: Timeout for webhook requests in seconds, range 1-15s
config.webhook_url_desc: The URL to receive event notifications, supports HTTP/HTTPS protocols
config.wgc_control_panel_only: This feature is only available in Sunshine Control Panel
config.wgc_disable_secure_desktop_desc: When using WGC capture, temporarily disable UAC prompts by auto-elevating admin requests without user confirmation. This allows seamless remote operation without UAC dialog interruptions. The original UAC settings are restored when streaming ends. WARNING: This reduces system security — any program requesting admin privileges will be silently elevated during streaming.
config.wgc_mode_switch_started: Mode switch initiated. If a UAC prompt appears, please click 'Yes' to confirm.
config.wgc_service_mode_warning: WGC capture requires running in user mode. If currently running in service mode, please click the button above to switch to user mode.
config.wgc_switch_to_service_mode_tooltip: Currently running in user mode. Click to switch to service mode.
config.wgc_switch_to_user_mode_tooltip: WGC capture requires running in user mode. Click this button to switch to user mode.
config.wgc_user_mode_available: Currently running in user mode. WGC capture is available.
config.window_title_desc: The title of the window to capture (partial match, case-insensitive). If left empty, the current running application name will be used automatically.

index.installed_version_not_stable: You are running a pre-release version of Sunshine. You may experience bugs or other issues. Please report any issues you encounter. Thank you for helping to make Sunshine a better software!
index.new_pre_release: A new Pre-Release Version is Available!
index.new_stable: A new Stable Version is Available!
index.startup_errors: Attention! Sunshine detected these errors during startup. We STRONGLY RECOMMEND fixing them before streaming.
index.update_download_confirm: You are about to open the update download page in your browser. Continue?
index.version_dirty: Thank you for helping to make Sunshine a better software!
index.version_latest: You are running the latest version of Sunshine

webhook.config_file_may_be_damaged: The Webhook configuration file may be damaged. Remove it.
webhook.description: Send a notification to your Webhook URL when a selected event occurs.
webhook.hot_apply_note: These settings are saved separately and take effect immediately. You do not need to restart Sunshine.
webhook.http_warning: HTTP sends Webhook data without transport encryption. Use HTTPS whenever possible.
webhook.save_runtime_unavailable: Webhook settings were saved, but the delivery service is currently unavailable. Sunshine will continue to run normally.
webhook.save_success: Webhook configuration was saved and applied immediately.
webhook.skip_ssl_verify_warning: Certificate verification is disabled. The HTTPS server identity will not be verified.
webhook.status_unknown: Current status has not been loaded
webhook.title: Webhook notifications
webhook.validation_url_invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without a username or password.

password.new_username_desc: If not specified, the username will not change
password.success_msg: Password has been changed successfully! This page will reload soon, your browser will ask you for the new credentials.

pin.delete_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to delete {name}?
pin.device_size_info: Device Size: Set the screen size type of the client device (Small - Phone, Medium - Tablet, Large - TV) to optimize streaming experience and touch operations.
pin.hdr_brightness_auto_info: HDR luminance uses the client's report automatically. Virtual displays advertise it directly; physical host displays keep their local HDR and color settings while stream metadata targets the client.
pin.hdr_profile_info: Physical-display ICC override (advanced): By default Sunshine uses client-reported luminance. VDD receives those capabilities directly; a physical host display is not modified. Select an installed ICC/ICM profile only when a physical display requires a temporary compatibility override. Sunshine restores the previous profile when streaming ends.
pin.pair_failure: Pairing Failed: Check if the PIN is typed correctly
pin.pair_success: Success! Please check Moonlight to continue
pin.qr_pairing_desc: Generate a QR code for quick pairing. Scan it with the Moonlight client to pair automatically.
pin.qr_pairing_warning: Experimental feature. If pairing fails, please use the manual PIN pairing below. Note: This feature only works on LAN.
pin.save_failed: Failed to save client settings. Please try again.
pin.save_or_cancel_first: Please save or cancel editing first
pin.unpair_all_confirm: Are you sure you want to unpair all clients? This action cannot be undone.
pin.warning_msg: Make sure you have access to the client you are pairing with. This software can give total control to your computer, so be careful!

setup.description: Let's get you started with a quick setup
setup.harmony_modal_desc: For HarmonyOS NEXT Moonlight, please search for Moonlight V+ in the HarmonyOS App Store
setup.harmony_modal_link_notice: This link will redirect to the project repository
setup.restart_desc: Configuration saved. Sunshine is restarting to apply display settings.
setup.setup_complete_desc: Basic settings are now active. You can start streaming with a Moonlight client right away!
setup.skip_confirm: Are you sure you want to skip the setup wizard? You can configure these options later in the settings page.
setup.step1_vdd_intro: The Base Display (VDD) is Foundation Sunshine's built-in smart virtual display, supporting any resolution, frame rate, and HDR optimization. It is the preferred choice for screen-off streaming and extended display streaming.
setup.step3_ensure_active_desc: Activates the display if it is not already active
setup.step3_ensure_only_display_desc: Disables all other displays, only enables the specified display (recommended)
setup.step3_ensure_primary_desc: Activates the display and sets it as the primary display
setup.step3_ensure_secondary_desc: Uses only the virtual display for secondary extended streaming
setup.step3_no_operation_desc: No changes to display state; user must ensure display is ready
setup.vdd_driver_browser_hint: Open the Sunshine desktop app on the host and install the driver from VDD settings, then come back and recheck.
setup.vdd_driver_desktop_hint: Sunshine can install the bundled driver now. Administrator approval is required.
setup.vdd_driver_required: ZakoVDD must be installed before this option can be used. The driver is selected by default in the installer and supports only Windows 10 22H2 or later.
setup.virtual_display_desc: Stream using a virtual display device (requires ZakoVDD driver installation)

troubleshooting.ai_key_local: API key is stored locally only and never uploaded
troubleshooting.boom_sunshine_desc: If you need to immediately shut down Sunshine, you can use this function. Note that you will need to manually start it again after shutdown.
troubleshooting.confirm_boom_desc: So you really want to exit? Well, I can't stop you, go ahead and click again
troubleshooting.confirm_logout_desc: You will need to enter your password again to access the web UI.
troubleshooting.force_close_desc: If Moonlight complains about an app currently running, force closing the app should fix the issue.
troubleshooting.logout_desc: Logout. You may need to log in again.
troubleshooting.logout_localhost_tip: Current environment does not require login; logout will not trigger a credential prompt.
troubleshooting.logs_desc: See the logs uploaded by Sunshine
troubleshooting.reopen_setup_wizard_desc: Reopen the setup wizard page to reconfigure initial settings.
troubleshooting.reset_display_device_desc_windows:
If Sunshine is stuck trying to restore the changed display device settings, you can reset the settings and proceed to restore the display state manually.
This could happen for various reasons: device is no longer available, has been plugged to a different port and so on.
troubleshooting.restart_sunshine_desc: If Sunshine isn't working properly, you can try restarting it. This will terminate any running sessions.
troubleshooting.unpair_desc: Remove your paired devices. Individually unpaired devices with an active session will remain connected, but cannot start or resume a session.
troubleshooting.unpair_single_success: However, the device(s) may still be in an active session. Use the 'Force Close' button above to end any open sessions.

welcome.create_creds: Before Getting Started, we need you to make a new username and password for accessing the Web UI.
welcome.create_creds_alert: The credentials below are needed to access Sunshine's Web UI. Keep them safe, since you will never see them again!
welcome.creds_local_only: Your credentials are stored locally offline and will never be uploaded to any server.
welcome.network_error: Network error, please check your connection
welcome.welcome_success: This page will reload soon, your browser will ask you for the new credentials
